text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited at all times on the south side of Heath Street West, between Avenue Road and a point 48 metres east. This will address concerns regarding parked vehicles obstructing sightlines for drivers exiting the rear parking lot of 575 Avenue Road and improve traffic flow along Heath Street West. This proposal will result in the loss of three parking spaces.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Heath Street West, between Avenue Road and a point 48 metres east. 2. Rescinded the existing maximum one-hour parking regulation in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., daily, on the south side of Heath Street West, between Avenue Road and a point 30.5 metres east of Oriole Road.
